hero.title: Stay at your school. Earn Pearson Edexcel International A-Levels. Reach the university you've been dreaming of.
hero.subtitle: Live online lessons with experienced teachers, exams at Pearson-approved centres, and full support from application to visa, all with one team.
hero.mobileTitle: The shortest route to the university abroad you dream of.
hero.mobileSubtitle: With A-Levels, skip the foundation year and apply straight to leading universities.
routeSteps: You study your A-Level subjects in live online lessons with experienced teachers. Lessons run after school, in the evenings and at weekends, so there is no need to leave your school. Regular mock exams track your progress, and parents get a written report every week.

The exams are not online: you sit them on paper at Pearson-approved centres. We choose the centre and the session, handle your registration and keep track of every deadline. There are three sessions a year: October, January and May–June.

Together we build a list of universities that fit your grades and goals. We prepare your personal statement, references and applications with you. The university makes the admission decision; we work to make your application as strong as it can be.

Once your offer arrives, we gather your student visa documents together and check the financial paperwork. Before the embassy interview, you do a practice interview with us. The consulate decides; we make sure nothing is missing.
We help you find a dormitory or other housing, book your travel and get ready to leave. That way you arrive in a new city calm and settle into your studies from day one.

cards.title: IGCSE and A-Level
cards.body: For students who want to start early. About 2 years of IGCSEs build a solid base in English and core subjects, followed by 2 years of A-Levels. You stay at your own school throughout.

cards.title: Straight to A-Level
cards.body: For students who want to get to university sooner. We choose 3 subjects for your future degree and prepare you to apply for a bachelor's in about 2 years. Depending on your level, it can take less.

price.body: Every student's goal is different, and so is our package. You pay only for the services you need.
